Ziro Festival Rhythm Expedition: Arunachal Pradesh

Guwahati — Ziro Valley — Apatani Hamlets — Guwahati

About This Trip

Journey into the misty, pine-scented sanctuaries of Ziro Valley, where golden paddy fields meet the raw, soul-stirring rhythms of independent music. Nestled at 5,500 feet, this 7-day overland odyssey immerses you in the heart of Arunachal Pradesh during its harvest season. Live under starlit skies in wilderness camps, experience the sustainable heritage of the ancient Apatani tribe, and gather around late-night bonfires amidst bamboo groves and indie melodies. Crafted for wanderers seeking genuine cultural depth and high-altitude harmony, this expedition seamlessly blends raw nomadic energy with curated Banjara hospitality.

Itinerary

Meet your Banjara trip captains in Guwahati and embark on a scenic overland drive across winding Himalayan foothills, arriving at our serene valley gateway by dusk.

Settle into our curated alpine campsite amidst golden rice terraces, soak in the warm Apatani hospitality, and enter the festival grounds as dusk sets over the Donyi-Polo bamboo stages.

Wander through ancient bamboo hamlets and pine groves with local tribal guides, explore sacred sights, and immerse yourself in an evening of global indie soundscapes.

Spend a soul-stirring day at the festival grounds, witnessing world-class sustainable bamboo architecture, before gathering for intimate acoustic campsite jamming under the stars.

Try traditional Apatani paddy field fishing, savor authentic regional delicacies and kiwi wine, and celebrate your final evening under the golden canopy of Ziro Valley.

Bid farewell to the valley of music and trace the winding roads back toward Guwahati, unwinding at a curated hotel stay for a restful evening.

Enjoy a relaxed morning breakfast with the group before departing with unforgettable memories of mountain rhythms and tribal warmth.
